200.description:
Official NFL injury and practice report for one week: every listed player with per-day practice participation (FULL/LIMITED/DIDNOT), practice injuries and the game-status designation (OUT/DOUBTFUL/QUESTIONABLE), league-wide or for one club.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number |  |
| `country` | string | Market the data is published for; always US. |
| `language` | string | always en |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | When this result was fetched (Unix ms). The feed publishes no update timestamp of its own; `report_date` is the source-effective date. |
| `report_date` | string | Newest practice date across the returned rows (YYYY-MM-DD): how far the clubs' filings for this week reach. A club's final report (with game designations) is filed on its last practice day, usually two days before its game (the day before a Thursday game); an earlier date means the week's report is still in progress. | `season` | number | Season year, e.g. 2026. |
| `season_type` | string | PRE, REG or POST. |
| `source_url` | string | https://www.nfl.com/injuries/league/<season>/<type><week> |
| `team` | object | The club filter as resolved from the feed; null for the league-wide report. |
| `week` | number | Week number within the season type. |
| `weeks_available` | number[] | Weeks that have rows in the season feed so far. |
